about.en: Eli Lilly bStock (LLYB) is a tokenized share of Eli Lilly and Company issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x5407912f1aa4b9e05cbe6abeb9721547a643ec6b, backed 1:1 by LLY shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
